title: A New Generation of Perspective API: Efficient Multilingual Character-level Transformers
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured unintended bias in toxicity models by evaluating their performance on synthetic, templated sentences containing religious identity terms. It specifically measured whether non-toxic comments containing these terms were incorrectly flagged as toxic, using metrics like Subgroup AUC, Background Positive Subgroup Negative (BPSN) AUC, and Background Negative Subgroup Positive (BNSP) AUC.
findings: The proposed UTC model generally performed better and showed less bias across various religious identity terms compared to the mT5-small baseline. While overall performance was strong (AUC > 0.7), the evaluation identified specific weaknesses where certain religious terms were still correlated with toxicity, leading to false positives, indicating a need for further debiasing work.
